answer: Make every identity earn its footing like layers of shale: a new agent starts with a tiny, time-locked deposit and can only take small jobs, and its reputation accrues slowly, grain by grain, as peers vouch for completed work. A sybil may pile a dune of fresh accounts on the knoll, but each one must still wait out the same slow season before it can touch real value - mass-producing shells costs time the attacker cannot fake, while honest agents build a solid record layer by layer.
